content: Windows has no /proc-style API to read a process's cwd. WMIC is removed on current Windows 11 builds (confirmed absent on this machine); the supported replacement is PowerShell Get-CimInstance Win32_Process, which exposes ProcessId and CommandLine only (no cwd). Empirically, claude.exe's CommandLine on this machine carries no repo-path argument at all (just the exe path, optionally --resume <session-id>), so per-repo attribution via cwd or cmdline is not reliably possible on Windows without native PEB-reading code.
